metadata.name: private_poll
metadata.description: VCoin private polls: encrypted ballots weighted by staking-protocol, threshold-decrypted by a Feldman-verified committee; assert_poll_passed lets a Realms proposal depend on the outcome

instructions.name: assert_poll_passed
docs: Fails unless the poll passed and this is its first use by its consumer.

instructions.name: cast_vote
docs: Casts an encrypted ballot (`R ‖ C` per choice) with its validity proof.

accounts.name: stake
docs: The voter's staking deposits.

accounts.name: user_score
docs: `staking_protocol::governance::five_a_score`.

instructions.name: create_poll
docs: Opens a poll. `consumer` is the only signer that may later consume a pass.

instructions.name: finalize_poll
docs: Settles the poll once with a verified tally.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates the config pointing at the staking registrar. Upgrade authority only.

instructions.name: set_committee
docs: Registers the decryption committee (authority = the DAO). Feldman-verified.

instructions.name: submit_share
docs: Committee member `member_index` (1-based) posts its partial decryption.

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Private polls are paused

errors.name: InvalidProgramData
errors.msg: Program data account does not belong to this program

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.msg: Poll parameters out of bounds

errors.name: CommitteeNotSet
errors.msg: No decryption committee has been registered

errors.name: InvalidCommittee
errors.msg: Committee must satisfy 3 <= threshold <= size <= 5 with distinct, non-default members

errors.name: FeldmanMismatch
errors.msg: A committee member key does not match the Feldman commitments

errors.name: InvalidSchedule
errors.msg: Start must be within 30 days and the voting period within the configured bounds

errors.name: CreatorWeightTooLow
errors.msg: Creator's lock-weighted stake is below the minimum to open a poll

errors.name: InvalidConsumer
errors.msg: Consumer must be set (e.g. the Realms governance PDA)

errors.name: PollNotOpen
errors.msg: Poll is not open for voting

errors.name: NoVotingWeight
errors.msg: No lock-weighted stake at the poll's end time

errors.name: ScoreBelowGate
errors.msg: 5A reputation score is below the voting gate

errors.name: InvalidBallotProof
errors.msg: Ballot proof rejected

errors.name: InvalidPoint
errors.msg: Invalid curve point

errors.name: NonCanonicalScalar
errors.msg: Non-canonical scalar

errors.name: VotingNotEnded
errors.msg: Voting has not ended

errors.name: RevealClosed
errors.msg: Reveal window is closed

errors.name: RevealStillOpen
errors.msg: Reveal window is still open

errors.name: NotCommitteeMember

errors.name: ShareAlreadySubmitted

errors.name: InvalidDleqProof

errors.name: NotEnoughShares

errors.name: InvalidLagrange

errors.name: TallyMismatch

errors.name: PollAlreadyFinal

errors.name: PollNotFinal

errors.name: PollNotPassed

errors.name: AlreadyConsumed

errors.name: WrongConsumer

errors.name: FinalizeInstead

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

types.name: AdminState
docs: Authority with a two-step, time-locked transfer.
`propose` (current authority) → wait [`AUTHORITY_TRANSFER_DELAY`] → `accept`
(new authority). The current authority can `cancel` at any time before acceptance.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when no transfer is pending.

fields.name: pending_since
docs: Unix time the pending transfer was proposed (0 when none).

types.name: BallotCast
docs: Carries the full ballot so anyone can recompute the poll's aggregates.

types.name: BallotRecord
docs: One per (poll, voter): prevents double voting. PDA `["ballot", poll, voter]`.

fields.name: ballot_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the 192-byte ballot (the ballot itself is in the transaction and event).

types.name: Committee
docs: Decryption committee registered by the DAO (audit ZK-03: not chosen per poll). Polls
snapshot it at creation, so a later change never affects a running poll.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Incremented on every change; 0 = never set.

fields.name: election_pk
docs: `commitments[0]`.

fields.name: commitments
docs: Feldman commitments `A_0..A_{threshold-1}` (unused slots zero).

fields.name: member_pks
docs: `member_pks[i] = Σ_k (i+1)^k·A_k`, verified at registration.

fields.name: member_authorities
docs: Wallet allowed to submit member `i + 1`'s decryption share.

types.name: DepositEntry
docs: One locked deposit.

types.name: Poll
docs: One poll, PDA `["poll", id]`.

fields.name: consumer
docs: The only signer that may consume a pass (e.g. the Realms governance PDA).

fields.name: weight_params
docs: Snapshot so every voter's weight uses the same parameters and timestamp.

fields.name: agg_r
docs: Running sums of every ballot's `R` and `C` per choice.

fields.name: shares_bitmap
docs: Bit `i` set = member `i + 1` submitted a verified share.

types.name: PollConfig
docs: Singleton, PDA `["poll-config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Bootstrapped by the upgrade authority, handed to the Realms governance PDA.

fields.name: registrar
docs: staking-protocol registrar whose voters vote here.

fields.name: quorum_bps
docs: Minimum total weight cast, as basis points of the maximum possible weight.

fields.name: pass_bps
docs: For must exceed this share (bps) of For + Against.

fields.name: min_creator_weight
docs: Poll weight units the creator must hold.

types.name: Registrar
docs: Singleton registrar, PDA `["registrar"]`. Owns the VCoin vault and is the only
account the veVCoin program accepts as mint/burn signer.

fields.name: admin
docs: Authority for pause, parameters and slashing. Bootstrapped by the deployer and handed
(24h two-step) to the Realms governance PDA after launch, so every change is a DAO vote.

fields.name: governance_program_id
docs: Realms (SPL Governance) program and realm this registrar serves as voter-weight plugin.

fields.name: realm_governing_token_mint
docs: The realm's community governing-token mint (the mint Realms votes are cast for).

fields.name: slash_destination
docs: Where slashed VCoin goes (DAO treasury token account).

fields.name: min_vote_score
docs: 5A composite score (0..=10000) required to vote / to create proposals.

fields.name: total_locked
docs: Sum of all deposits (receipt supply upper bound; drives MaxVoterWeightRecord).

types.name: Voter
docs: Per-owner deposits, PDA `["voter", owner]`.

fields.name: pending_slashes
docs: Open slash requests against this voter; withdrawals are frozen while > 0.

types.name: WeightParams
docs: Voting-weight parameters (fixed point, [`FACTOR_SCALE`] = 1.0×).
